main_text.p: Te, te prisca fides, Verique clientula mater Religio, ô adsis portus & aura, vocant: Ne turpes agitent nostra de clade triumphos, Qui nunc de superum prælia sede movent. Sed nec ades, nec abis: quia te mors invida terris Eripuit, gelido composuitque sinu, Haud ideo ereptus nobis. Tua conscius orbis Edita mutato nomine scripta legit, Plurimaque Ursini sub nomine posthuma, lucem Si modo contigerint, quam meruere, leget, Arte laborata, & niveum testantia pectus: Non his livor edax, non nigra bilis inest, Qua modo Cadmæos rapiens in prælia fratres Scripta Lycambæo tincta cruore vomit: Næve tuis desint meritis qui congrua reddant Præmia, ut æternus nominis exstet honos: Surget in hoc olim, doctis pro cultibus, arvo Docta tibi Libyca fertilitate seges. Tunc (liceat plausus isti modo tollere) victrix Causa triumphabit robore justa suo. Et prius Ursinos uno pro mille dabit, quàm Exul ab æthērio culmine Christus eat, Lustret & humano terras stygiamque paludem Corpore: quod finxit conditor Utopia. Credimus, ille equidem præsenti numine complet Cuncta: sed & cœlo carne receptus agit. Carne, inquam, superósque locos & regna sequestrans, Nostrum sibi nunc certa stat πολιτευμα[?] fide. Carneque quem nobis tandem sine fraude reducet Conspicuum aeria nube suprema dies. At nos, clare tuam vir, quo decorabimus urnam Carmine? sic habeat qui tegit ossa lapis: Hac cubat Ursini funus lacrymabile tumba: Mens fruitur cœlo: fama sed orbe viget.
main_text.head: EPICEDION IN OBITVM EIVSDEM D. ZACHA-RIAE URSINI, EODEM DAVIDE Pareo authore.
main_text.p: SI quid ab extremo foret inviolabile fato, Tristeque Parcarum sisque retardet opus:

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Line 28 Greek word "πολιτευμα" is uncertain in its accents and final letter. Spelling changed to u/v and i/j convention (Vrsini to Ursini, liuor to livor, iusta to justa, inuida to invida, vno to uno, vrnam to urnam, Vtopia to Utopia). Marks in the left margin (small figures and symbols near lines) are not clear printed text and are not transcribed.
